03 / METHODOLOGY

Real data.
Clear boundaries.

Ames Housing records 2,930 residential sales in Ames, Iowa from 2006 to 2010. This model uses eight property features and neighborhood to predict individual sale prices.

A separate test set measures generalization.

The model does not account for today's market, renovation details, or locations outside Ames. Rare or unusual feature combinations can be unreliable. Time-based calibration may be affected by market shifts.
